subject: AXPress on Mixer channel-strip routing slots, and selecting a destination by name
question: Do the routing slots open a menu, and can a destination be chosen by title with the slot reading it back?

reverify.expected: the press opens 2+ menus with 20+ distinct enabled titles; selecting 'Output 3-4' changes the slot readback; Edit > Undo restores the original destination
reverify.cost: needs Logic open with the Mixer showing; MUTATES one strip's output and undoes it; ~25 s

method: Logic activated and the frontmost bundle id printed in the same run. A track-header Mute toggled off->on->off first as the run's POSITIVE CONTROL, so a silent instrument cannot pass as a silent surface. The slot pressed, every AXMenu swept, every enabled AXMenuItem's title and duplicate-count recorded, then Escape and the menu count confirmed back to zero. For the mutating half, exactly one enabled item with the wanted title is required -- a duplicate is a refusal, not a pick -- and after selecting, the slot's AXDescription is re-read from a fresh sweep. Restored through Edit > Undo, whose effect is verified by re-reading the slot rather than by the osascript return, because osascript returns the menu item's name whether or not the click lands. NOT done: no Send or Group slot was selected from, only read; no locale other than en-US; the Mixer was open throughout and a Mixer-closed run was not tried.

observations.reading: Output slot menus opened by that press
Logic's undo stack named the change
observations.value: Undo Change Output in Channel Strip

observations.reading: recovery from the 'No Output' state without undo, menus at 0/5/15/30s
output slots after restore: Stereo Output / output / No Output

conclusion: AXPress on a Mixer routing slot opens its destination menu, and a destination can be selected by title with the slot reading back the new value. The Output slot exposes 273 distinct enabled titles out of 274; selecting 'Output 3-4' moved the slot from 'Stereo Output' and Logic recorded it as 'Change Output in Channel Strip'. Both halves of the coordinate-free write are therefore reachable. The slot reports AXEnabled=false and the press returns kAXErrorCannotComplete throughout, so neither is a refusal here.
limits: supersedes the 2026-09-09 record, which read the SLOT'S OWN VALUE after the press; a press never changes that, so that reading could not have observed a success and its 'wall' verdict was about the instrument

routing a strip to 'No Output' leaves it with NO menu to open afterwards -- measured, and it does not recover after 30s or by pressing another element, only by changing the destination back. A caller must not treat that as a failure of the press
'Stereo Output' appears twice among the Output menu's enabled titles, so an implementation must refuse or disambiguate rather than take the first
only the Output slot was SELECTED from; Send and Group slots were read but never actuated
read in en-US; every title here is a localised string and must be addressed through AXLocalePolicy, never as a literal
one host, one project, one strip; the bus and track names are this project's
the Mixer window was open for every run; whether an Inspector-only strip behaves the same was not tested
